entities.name: Scattered Spider
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider is a cybercriminal group that targets large companies and their contracted information technology (IT) help desks.

entities.name: AveMaria
entities.evidence: AveMaria (also known as WarZone [S0670]) Enables remote access to a targeted organization’s systems.

entities.name: Raccoon Stealer
entities.evidence: Raccoon Stealer [S1148] Steals information including login credentials [TA0006], browser history [T1217], cookies [T1539], and other data.

entities.name: VIDAR Stealer
entities.evidence: VIDAR Stealer Steals information including login credentials, browser history, cookies, and other data.

entities.name: RattyRAT
entities.evidence: RattyRAT Java-based remote access trojan, used for persistent, stealth access and internal reconnaissance.

entities.name: DragonForce Ransomware
entities.evidence: DragonForce Ransomware Infiltrates networks, encrypts data, and demands ransom.

entities.name: Fleetdeck.io
entities.evidence: Fleetdeck.io Enables remote monitoring and management of systems.

entities.name: Level.io
entities.evidence: Level.io Enables remote monitoring and management of systems.

entities.name: Mimikatz
entities.evidence: Mimikatz [S0002] Extracts credentials from a system.

entities.name: Ngrok
entities.evidence: Ngrok [S0508] Enables remote access to a local web server by tunneling over the internet.

entities.name: Pulseway
entities.evidence: Pulseway Enables remote monitoring and management of systems.

entities.name: Screenconnect
entities.evidence: Screenconnect Enables remote connections to network devices for management.

entities.name: Splashtop
entities.evidence: Splashtop Enables remote connections to network devices for management.

entities.name: Tactical.RMM
entities.evidence: Tactical.RMM Enables remote monitoring and management of systems.

entities.name: Tailscale
entities.evidence: Tailscale Provides virtual private networks (VPNs) to secure network communications.

entities.name: TeamViewer
entities.evidence: TeamViewer Enables remote connections to network devices for management.

entities.name: Teleport.sh
entities.evidence: Teleport.sh Enables remote access to a local system by tunneling over the internet.

entities.name: AnyDesk
entities.evidence: AnyDesk Enables remote access to network devices for management, bypassing security alerts due to AnyDesk being a legitimate application.

entities.name: Social Engineering
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors use multiple social engineering techniques—including push bombing—and subscriber identity module (SIM) swap attacks, to obtain credentials, install remote access tools, and/or bypass multi-factor authentication (MFA).

entities.name: Phishing
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors Posed as company IT and/or helpdesk staff using phone calls or SMS messages to obtain credentials from employees and gain access to the network [T1598] [T1656].

entities.name: Remote Access
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors Posed as company IT and/or helpdesk staff to direct employees to run commercial remote access tools enabling initial access [T1204] [T1219] [T1566].

entities.name: Multi-Factor Authentication Bypass
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors Posed as IT staff to convince employees to share their one-time password (OTP), an MFA authentication code.

entities.name: MFA Fatigue
entities.evidence: Sent repeated MFA notification prompts leading to employees pressing the “Accept” button (also known as MFA fatigue) [T1621].

entities.name: SIM Swap
entities.evidence: Convinced cellular carriers to transfer control of a targeted user’s phone number to a SIM card in their possession, gaining control over the phone and access to MFA prompts.

entities.name: Data Exfiltration
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors have observably exfiltrated data [TA0010] after gaining access and threatened to release it without deploying ransomware.

entities.name: Ransomware
entities.evidence: DragonForce Ransomware Infiltrates networks, encrypts data, and demands ransom.

entities.name: Commercial facilities
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors against the commercial facilities sectors, subsectors, and other sectors.

entities.name: Scattered Spider

entities.name: Gather Victim Identity
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors gather usernames, passwords, and PII for targeted organizations.

entities.name: Phishing for Information
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors use phishing to obtain login credentials, gaining access to a targeted organization’s network.

entities.name: Search Closed Sources: Purchase Technical Data
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors purchase credentials from illicit marketplaces.

entities.name: Search Victim-Owned Websites
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors search targeted organization-owned websites to gather information such as work roles and contact information.

entities.name: Phishing
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors use broad phishing attempts against a target to obtain information used to gain initial access.

entities.name: Phishing (Mobile)
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors send SMS messages, known as smishing, when targeting an organization.

entities.name: Phishing: Spearphishing Voice
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors use voice communications to convince IT help desk personnel to reset passwords and/or MFA tokens.

entities.name: Trusted Relationship
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors abuse trusted relationships of contracted IT help desks to gain access to targeted organizations.

entities.name: Valid Accounts: Domain Accounts
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors obtain access to valid domain accounts to gain initial access to a targeted organization.

entities.name: Serverless Execution
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors use ETL tools to collect data in cloud environments.

entities.name: User Execution
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors impersonating helpdesk personnel direct employees to run commercial remote access tools thereby enabling access to the targeted organization’s network.

entities.name: Persistence
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors seek to maintain persistence on a targeted organization’s network.

entities.name: Create Account
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors create new user identities in the targeted organization.

entities.name: Modify Authentication Process: Multi-Factor Authentication
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors may modify MFA tokens to gain access to a targeted organization’s network.

entities.name: Valid Accounts
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors abuse and control valid accounts to maintain network access even when passwords are changed.

entities.name: Privilege Escalation
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors escalate account privileges when on a targeted organization’s network.

entities.name: Domain Policy Modification: Domain Trust Modification
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors add a federated identity provider to the targeted organization’s SSO tenant and activate automatic account linking.

entities.name: Modify Cloud Compute Infrastructure: Create Cloud Instance
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors create cloud instances for use during lateral movement and data collection.

entities.name: Impersonation
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors pose as company IT and/or helpdesk staff to gain access to targeted organization’s networks.

entities.name: Credential Access
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors use tools, such as Raccoon Stealer, to obtain login credentials.

entities.name: Forge Web Credentials
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors may forge MFA tokens to gain access to a targeted organization’s network.

entities.name: Multi-Factor Authentication Request Generation
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider sends repeated MFA notification prompts to lead employees to accept the prompt and gain access to the target network.

entities.name: Unsecured Credentials: Credentials in Files
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors search for insecurely stored credentials on targeted organization’s systems.

entities.name: Unsecured Credentials: Private Keys
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors search for insecurely stored private keys on targeted organization’s systems.

entities.name: SIM Swap
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors steal OTPs, credentials, and security answers.

entities.name: Discovery
entities.evidence: Upon gaining access to a targeted network, Scattered Spider threat actors seek out SharePoint sites, credential storage documentation, VMware vCenter, infrastructure backups and enumerate AD to identify useful information to support further operations.

entities.name: Browser Information Discovery
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors use tools (e.g., Racco, Raccoon Stealer) to obtain browser histories.

entities.name: Cloud Service Dashboard
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors leverage AWS Systems Manager Inventory to discover targets for lateral movement.

entities.name: File and Directory Discovery
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors search a compromised network to discover files and directories for further information or exploitation.

entities.name: Remote System Discovery
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors search for infrastructure, such as remote systems, to exploit.

entities.name: Steal Web Session Cookie
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors use tools, such as Raccoon Stealer, to obtain browser cookies.

entities.name: Lateral Movement
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors laterally move across a target network upon gaining access and establishing persistence.

entities.name: Remote Services: Cloud Services
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors use pre-existing cloud instances for lateral movement and data collection.

entities.name: Collection
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors search code repositories for data collection and exfiltration.

entities.name: Data Staged

entities.name: Email Collection
entities.evidence: Scattered Spider threat actors search targeted organization’s emails to determine if the organization has detected the intrusion and initiated any security response.
